title: Lucas County EMS: Trauma Activation — Multi-Vehicle Crash with Fuel Tanker

lines.text: Ottawa River, this is Lucas County EMS Dispatch. We have a major multi-vehicle crash on I-75 near the Maumee River crossing. Fuel tanker involved, fire on scene. First wave: 14 patients, six critical. ETA 12 minutes. You are our designated trauma center. Are you accepting? Confirm now.
Ottawa River, confirm acceptance or advise on alternate routing. We have three ambulances en route with patients, and more are expected.
Ottawa River, we are holding two ambulances at the interchange. You are our only trauma facility on call. Please respond.

fields.voiceStyle: Young female, urgent, clipped, with background radio chatter and sirens

instructorNote: This is a critical decision point. The AOC and EDMD must declare Code Triage and activate the HCC. Watch for immediate coordination to begin.
